cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Help Me Keep This Quiet
cards.instruction: Get someone to help contain a secret without first revealing its full risk or purpose.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Hide this envelope under the picnic hamper before Mum comes in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She asked me to unpack the hamper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then keep the envelope in your pocket while you unpack.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll end up taking it home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect. I'll explain when she stops asking where it is.
